foundation.placement: Native local XY uses verified source-to-native basis. Unit column top is0m, bottom-1m. Translate top to body base plus original source_support_top_z_m; stretch ONLY vertical depth beneath terrain. Never recenter XY or use uniform mesh scale.
foundation.overlap_policy: All individual contact columns preserved, including positive XY overlaps, coplanar top faces and coincident/touching boundaries. Measured positive-area pairs are flagged per asset; no union or invented pad.
foundation.holes_policy: Caps are original measured contact triangles, not bounding boxes or new triangulated hulls. Closed boundary side walls preserve all9 holes.

yaw_pivot_measurement.method: Midpoint of measured collar min/max; vertical axis through actual collar centre

wind.hierarchy: Building/entity presentation rotates stationary root and all children. Weather yaw rotates only YawNacelle about measured collar Z axis. SpinRotor is its child, offset axle-yawPivot, spinning around rotor-local source Y. Stationary mast/seams/door/access remain fixed to their path.
wind.rest_reassembly: stationary_local; yaw_local+yawPivot; spin_local+rotorAxle. Apply weather yaw about yawPivot to the yaw and rotor branches only, then rotor spin in rotor-local coordinates.

predicted_native.basis: [x,-y,z]*100; nuclear334 measured, new wind roles await actual native verification
predicted_native.reflection: Negative determinant changes angular handedness; verify weather-yaw and spin signs in native runtime, separately from entity presentation yaw.
